Exact alarms are off, so check-ins may arrive a few minutes late.
Battery optimisation can still delay check-ins.

Android may hold back alarms while the phone sleeps to save battery, which can make a check-in arrive late. To keep them on time, open the battery settings, choose Planner and pick \"Don\'t optimise\" (or \"Unrestricted\"). Planner only wakes the phone for its own check-ins.
